claims.statement: Theorem CLAW (W74, in-package): every claw-free graph (no induced K1,3) on n >= 1 vertices satisfies max(alpha, omega) >= (1/2)*n^(1/3). Proof: (1) N(v) has no independent 3-set (else induced claw) and no omega-clique (else +v is a bigger clique), so |N(v)| <= R(omega,3)-1 <= omega(omega+1)/2-1 < omega^2 by the elementary Ramsey bound R(t,3) <= t(t+1)/2; (2) Caro-Wei weak form alpha >= n/(dbar+1) > n/(omega^2+1); (3) case split at omega = n^(1/3). Hence H = K1,3 (claw) and, by complement transfer (complement of K3+K1 is K1,3, alpha/omega swap), H = K3+K1 satisfy the Erdos-Hajnal property with every c < 1/3. The in-package 4-vertex coverage grows from ten graphs to twelve.
claims.verification: full derivation in FAMILY_PROOF.md section 4.5 (Theorem CLAW, zero premises); driver S-CLAW (line graphs of random graphs + clique unions + filtered randoms all claw-free: alpha >= n/(omega^2+1) and max(alpha,omega) >= 0.5*n^(1/3) at every instance; R(3,3)=6 exhaustive over all 2^15 six-vertex graphs; negative control: star K1,5 violates the degree law deg < omega^2)

claims.statement: Theorem PAW (complete, zero premises, CORRECTED W75 final form): every paw-free graph (no induced paw = triangle with pendant edge) on n >= 1 vertices satisfies max(alpha, omega) >= sqrt(n/5). Proof: components are triangle-free (alpha_i >= sqrt(m_i)/2 by the max-degree/Caro-Wei split — N(v) independent in triangle-free graphs — so m_i <= 4*alpha_i^2) or complete multipartite (the Olariu structure theorem, re-derived in-package: every vertex adjacent to >= 2 of any triangle via the paw exclusion on shortest paths; non-adjacency transitive via the shared-attachment paw; alpha_i*omega_i >= m_i so m_i <= alpha_i*omega_i). Summing: n <= 4*alpha^2 + alpha*omega <= 5*max(alpha,omega)^2. The triangle-free subfamily satisfies the stronger alpha >= sqrt(n)/2; the alpha-ONLY form is FALSE for general paw-free graphs (the engine's negative control: the complete 16-partite graph with parts of 2 — paw-free, alpha=2 < sqrt(32)/2, omega=16 carries).

claims.statement: Theorem DIAMOND (complete, zero premises): every diamond-free graph (no induced K4 - e) on n >= 1 vertices satisfies max(alpha, omega) >= n^(1/3)/2.
